text:
mariela_pm: Hey team – Marvela's LATAM pilot is ramping faster than we predicted. They asked for a short-term throughput bump + header-based allowlisting so their edge proxy can route to our Sao Paulo region. This is a renewal-risk account; want to be proactive. Can we grant for 72h and audit after? :thinking:

sarah.cs: Thanks for flagging. Do we have traffic numbers and the exact header they want whitelisted?

mariela_pm: Traffic: ~12 req/s steady with 250ms p95, spikes to 85 req/s during demo traffic. They expect ~50k tokens/day during the next 3 days. Header is X-Marvela-Instance: prod-demo-01. They only need access from a set of customer IPs (listed below).

mariela_pm: IPs:
- 18.201.45.12
- 18.201.45.13
- 200.10.5.34

mariela_pm: Header example: ```
X-Marvela-Instance: prod-demo-01
```

tony.ops: We can do temporary rate window and header pin. I need a config snippet for the infra change (so eng-infra can apply), and an owner for rollback.

net-eng: @tony.ops I can push the network CIDR + header rule. I'll also add a sticky routing rule to route requests with that header to sa-east-1 pool. Can you confirm the duration?

mariela_pm: 72 hours starting now would be ideal. Please also add a 24h auto-revoke and notify the CS owner if usage stays >60% of the allowance.

tony.ops: Working on the snippet. Proposed policy: ```json
{"target_region":"sa-east-1","match":{"header":"X-Marvela-Instance: prod-demo-01","source_ips":["18.201.45.12/32","18.201.45.13/32","200.10.5.34/32"]},"quota":{"qps":120,"duration":"72h"},"autorevoke":"24h"}```

sarah.cs: LGTM. Who signs off on SLA changes? We should document in the renewal playbook and add a customer note about the temporary exemption.

mariela_pm: I'll add the note. Also want a quick eval after 48h to check for regressions in latency and any token cost surprises.

net-eng: Applied staging rule, will push to prod in ~15m. tagging @deploy-bot for rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout to prod (change-id: roll-657891). 2/3 hosts updated. Monitoring alerts will suppress noisy alerts for 1h.

tony.ops: Prod rule applied. Rate limit increased to 120 qps for the matched header+IPs. Auto-revoke scheduled for 72h from now, with 24h pre-warning. Owner: mariela_pm.

sarah.cs: Thanks. Please ping if anything unexpected. I'll add to the customer renewal tracker and schedule the 48h check-in. :thumbsup:

mariela_pm: Great — appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll coordinate the 48h evaluation with Marvela and update the renewal notes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete (change-id: roll-657891). No errors.

net-eng: Logging the change in infra-audit with link to this thread. Will also export token-cost delta after 48h.

mariela_pm: Closing the loop here once the 48h eval is done. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
